decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Site Location Plan, Unnumbered Existing Block Plan, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Matrix, 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008 Rev. A, 009 Rev. A, 001-1 Rev. A, 002-1-01, 003-1, 004-1, 004-2, 005-1 Rev. B, 006-1 Rev. B, 006-1 Rev. A, 007-1 Rev. A, 008-1, 009-1 Rev. A Received: 01 February 2016 005-1 Rev. B, Unnumbered Soffit Detail - Side Infill Extension, Unnumbered Bedford Park style window/door profile Rev. A Received: 17 February 2016 Unnumbered Side Infill Extension Section Received: 15 March 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - All windows hereby approved shall be single glazed, white painted timber framed and so maintained.
description:
Erection of a single storey rear extension with skylight to roof terrace.Alterations to roof, new roof windows,  replacement of doors and windows, erection of recycling and cycle storage to front and internal alterations to convert from HMO to a single family dwellinghouse.
(Listed Building Consent)
